root_cause: Public positioning and existing generated messages could still communicate Bedrijfsgeheugen as a generic AI-enabled automation provider instead of its continuous business-steering proposition.
prevention_rule: In the existing company-facing channel generator, frame measurable business value first: internal and external signal to strategic impact, assigned decision/action, measurable result and learning.
